registration: docs/screen01_registration_2026_10_30.md section 9 (kernel loss), section 5.11.17, section 10 (freeze 1); revised 2026-10-31 after the source review (R3/B3, adoption.md)
default_statement: A formal kernel without a harness-verified table (ended ERROR, no output, or DONE but failing verify) whose evidence matches none of the signatures below is classified NOT_INFRASTRUCTURE (cause not recognised). The classification is a record of the cause; it does not change the rerun rule. A kernel that ended DONE and passes harness verify is complete.
rerun_rule: One identical rerun per lost formal kernel, whatever the classification (registration section 9): the campaign, the states, the phase and the pinned runner are the same bytes, the first verified output is authoritative, both attempts are archived, so a rerun cannot select on a force and only spends session wall (section 4.3). `analyze_screen01.py infra --out` writes the classification record of every attempt. A kernel without a verified table after its rerun is declared --lost KERNEL=ID, citing the id of the signature its evidence matched (NOT_INFRASTRUCTURE when none) and the classification record of the failed rerun. No third attempt; a cap is never raised, a state never removed from its kernel.

classes.INFRA_LOSS: the Kaggle session, the Julia install, the GPU or the platform failed
classes.RUN_LOSS: a registered run failed inside the solver or the harness budget (divergence, non-finite output, cap trip, crash); deterministic reproduction expected, rerun once all the same

evidence: ERROR.txt of the kernel output directory, the Kaggle log (JSON list of {stream_name, time, data}; plain text is accepted), the text of `kaggle kernels status`, harness_index.json of the output directory, and the stderr of `scripts/fid01/fid01_harness.py verify` when verify failed (--verify-log).

signatures.source: stderr of harness verify of the kernel output (regex search; only when verify failed)
signatures.pattern: state fields or forces are not finite|must be a finite number
signatures.condition: verify failed and its message matches the pattern (a state whose summary flags or forces are non-finite: a divergent run; the harness verify is all-or-nothing, so the kernel has no table)
signatures.meaning: a run diverged or produced a non-finite force; the kernel is lost whole

signatures.source: harness verify of the kernel output (scripts/fid01/fid01_harness.py verify)
signatures.condition: the kernel output fails harness verify for any other reason (checked before the output-directory signatures, also for a kernel that wrote DONE)
signatures.meaning: the output cannot be trusted (identity, pins, hashes, GPU, budget bookkeeping); loss of the kernel

signatures.condition: the output directory has neither DONE nor ERROR.txt (the session ended without the runner's terminal marker)
signatures.meaning: a session kill: the runner never reached its DONE or ERROR branch

signatures.source: ERROR.txt, Kaggle log, status text (regex search)
signatures.pattern: Pkg\.instantiate failed|Julia archive SHA-256 mismatch|Unsatisfiable requirements|RegistryException|Could not resolve host|Temporary failure in name resolution
signatures.condition: the pattern matches and harness_index.json lists no complete state
signatures.meaning: Julia install or Pkg.instantiate failure before any state ran (a failure after a state completed is not this signature)

signatures.source: ERROR.txt, Kaggle log, status text (regex search)
signatures.pattern: independent CUDA device UUID probe failed|observed CUDA singleton/default UUID differs|must be a Tesla T4|physical GPU index 0 must occur|nvidia-smi inventory|no CUDA-capable device|CUDA_ERROR_NO_DEVICE
signatures.meaning: GPU identity mismatch in the harness probe (not a Tesla T4, wrong or missing device, UUID differs from the selected GPU)

signatures.source: ERROR.txt, Kaggle log, status text (regex search)
signatures.pattern: Bad Gateway|Service Unavailable|Gateway Time-?out|Internal Server Error|<!DOCTYPE html>
signatures.meaning: a Kaggle platform error page or a `kaggle kernels status` error

signatures.source: ERROR.txt, Kaggle log (regex search; the runner's own message, campaign_runner_template.py)
signatures.pattern: registered per-state or aggregate solver wall-time budget exceeded
signatures.meaning: a state exceeded its per-state cap or the kernel its aggregate cap (a slow session or a slow state); the runner stopped and the kernel has no table

signatures.source: ERROR.txt, Kaggle log (regex search; the runner's own message)
signatures.meaning: a Julia job exited non-zero or left no CSV / summary / W4_JOB_DONE (a crash or a solver failure of that state); the runner stopped and the kernel has no table
